profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN, with SEC CIK 0001441683. Its site describes it as providing AI automation for critical business processes, orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing the systems customers already run. The company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years.

The site states that Appian was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), and it points to an AI Value Study produced with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services and to a Gartner assessment of 20 BOAT vendors. Described capabilities include process automation, giving AI reliability and control, modernizing legacy applications, and building AI-powered apps without code, including embedding AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. Named use cases cover accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and supplier data, audit and compliance, case management, procure-to-pay, onboarding, order intake and fulfillment, and contract review. The site says AI automation cuts onboarding time by up to 50%.

Litigation data associated with the company counts 152 cases in Virginia.
